method.description: Controlled physiological series from published resting-HR / HRV / sleep distributions with injected deterioration windows. Detector is the production personal-baseline early-warning code (robust z-scores + 72 h projection).
references: Cooney MT et al. Eur J Prev Cardiol 2010 (resting HR).
Fang SC et al. JACC 2020 (HRV and adverse cardiac events).
Cappuccio FP et al. Eur Heart J 2011 (short sleep).

limitations: Streams are synthetic, grounded in published vital distributions, not continuous recordings from real patients with labelled outcomes.
Deterioration patterns are smooth ramps; abrupt clinical events may differ.
Weights in the strain index are transparent PoC choices, not fitted to outcomes.
No South-Asian wearable outcome cohort was available under an open licence for this PoC.
